name: Two-Stage Vector Quantization (VQ) for SH-AC
definition: A two-stage VQ process where Stage 1 quantizes the full 45-dimensional SH-AC vector coarsely, and Stage 2 quantizes the residual vector using grouped sub-vectors.
summary: Two-Stage VQ for SH-AC compresses 3D Gaussian Splatting coefficients by separately quantizing coarse shape and grouped residual details using distinct codebooks.
